title: handle_move does redundant actor fetches
description: inbox.rs handle_move (line 1456-1637) fetches the old actor twice: first via fetch_and_upsert_actor (line 1483), then immediately re-fetches the raw document with a manual HTTP GET (lines 1487-1506) to check alsoKnownAs. The first fetch is discarded (line 1484: let _ = old_actor). The same pattern repeats for the new actor: fetch_and_upsert_actor (line 1541) followed by another manual GET (lines 1549-1562). fetch_actor already parses the JSON document -- the alsoKnownAs check could be done on the already-fetched data if RemoteActorData carried that field, eliminating 2 redundant HTTP round trips per Move.
